statement: The original DS4 USB pairing feature 0x12's exact retail payload and semantics are not independently captured in this corpus; Linux asks for a 16-byte response and uses its first six payload bytes as device identity.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 346–353, 2148–2175. Note historic hid-sony used feature 0x81 instead; firmware-specific device feature support needs a reference.
